[[File:Depth_charge.png|thumb|Depth charges used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].]]
'''Depth charges''' were underwater warfare weapons intended to damage or destroy [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] vehicles and troops. They exploded upon contact.

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1 battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] ordered depth charges placed in [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] to flush out the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] from the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] used depth charges against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] underwater forces during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]].
